ht0s6b64.baseName: Walplus 200 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
ht0s6b64.variantName: Walplus 200 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
ht0s6b64.sourceDescription: The fully-decorated Christmas tree with stylish illuminated branches and colourful baubles creates a nice atmosphere in the coming Christmas. The artificial tree is made of PVC, which is lightweight and weather-resistant. The Christmas tree has an IP rating of IP44 and is, therefore, suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use. The branches can be arranged in any shape you like. They also contain 200 LEDs, which are very energy-efficient and emit a bright warm light. Designed with 4 different lighting effects, continuous lighting, twinkling, crossfade and slowly glowing mode, the lights beautifully illuminate in your preferred pattern. It is a real eye-catcher, especially in the evening. It can also serve as an ambient light source. This Christmas tree can be used every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Note: The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Product Specifications Tree colour: White Bauble colour: Gold and silver Material: PVC, steel Tree height: 180 cm Maximum tree diameter: 90 cm Voltage: 5 V⎓ Power: 3 W USB interface With 200 LEDs With 564 branches With 4 lighting effects Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree with 200 LEDs 1 x 20 cm silver tree topper 30 x 4 cm bauble (15 x gold and 15 x silver) 30 x 6 cm bauble (15 x gold and 15 x silver) 20 x Pine cone This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

hf9dj5h1.baseName: Christmas Tree World 80cm Gold Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball - Pack of 1
hf9dj5h1.variantName: Christmas Tree World 80cm Gold Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball - Pack of 1
hf9dj5h1.sourceDescription: Introducing the 80cm Inflatable Mirror Display Ball in Gold, a striking and versatile decorative solution designed to create instant impact in retail environments, commercial venues, events, exhibitions, and the home. Featuring a sleek mirror finish, this inflatable display ball reflects light and surroundings beautifully, making it ideal for eye-catching shop windows, visual merchandising, brand activations, and large-scale installations. A key advantage for commercial users is ease of storage. Once deflated or with the air removed using a compatible electric pump the display ball folds down to a fraction of its inflated size, making off-season storage simple and space-efficient. Manufactured from fire-retardant materials, the Inflatable Mirror Display Ball is suitable for use in commercial and public spaces. It is inflated once, sealed securely, and displayed without the need for a continuous power supply. Product Features • Size: 80cm (other sizes available) • Colour: Gold (other colours available) • Finish: High-gloss mirror effect • Material: Durable inflatable construction • Fire-resistant: Fire retardant material • Indoor & outdoor use • Installation options: Floor-standing, ceiling-hung, wall-mounted or secured to ground • Inflation: Inflated once and sealed no continuous air supply required • Storage: Fully deflates to take up minimal storage space • Pump: Electric air pump not included • Oversized gold bauble caps not included • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB
